steps: Rinse the dalia and moong dal together and soak them in water for 20 to 30 minutes.
Heat the ghee in a pressure cooker on medium heat and add the cumin and hing. Let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the onion, ginger and green chilli and fry for 3 to 4 minutes, until the onion is soft and light golden.
Add the tomato, turmeric and salt and cook, stirring, until the tomato is soft and mushy.
Stir in the carrot, potato, peas and chilli powder and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
Drain the dalia and dal, add them and stir on medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes.
Pour in about 400 ml water a person, close the cooker and cook on medium heat for 2 to 3 whistles.
Let the pressure drop on its own, stir, add a little hot water if it is too thick, and serve warm.
note: All three sources cook the dalia with moong dal, so it is added. Sources use 27 to 80 g of dalia a person; 50 g plus the dal makes a full breakfast bowl. The vegetables are kept small because they bulk up the bowl.
